title: ACR MCP data_catalog Request v1
description: Input for the data_catalog tool. Every field is optional. No sections means every section.

sections.description: Which catalogue sections to return. Omit it for all of them: operations (the allowlisted run_operation operations for your credential, with variables, scope rules and limits), facts (the fact kinds read_facts serves), subjects (subject kinds), relationships (relationship types and their end kinds) limits (size and page bounds) and schema (the allowed part of the ops GraphQL schema that graphql_query accepts for your credential).
